name: Juice Stop Encinitas
notes: restaurant's own site (juicestopencinitas.com) is dead (ENOTFOUND); DoorDash page confirms exact address match ('Encinitas CA, 1042 N El Camino Real' = worklist '1042 N El Camino Real C, Encinitas, CA 92024'); restaurant's own online-ordering menu page (juicestop-menus.html) was rejected as a source — it showed all items as literal $0.00 placeholders; prices instead taken from DoorDash's embedded Menu JSON-LD raw-cents integer field (e.g. "price":540), divided by 100. Cent-ending distribution across 68 items: {20:1,30:4,34:2,40:46,48:1,50:1,56:3,64:1,66:2,80:1,84:2,94:3,95:1}. The dominant .40 ending (46/68) is a single flat base price shared by ~27 standard smoothie flavors, not a rotating divisor sweep; premium/specialty smoothies and non-smoothie items (juices, supplements, snacks) carry genuinely distinct, non-uniform cent endings (.56/.94/.84/.48/.30/.95/.66/.20/.50/.64) — consistent with real flat-rate + tiered-upcharge menu pricing, not a computed/fee-inflated pattern. Marketplace-only source (medium confidence), no first-party cross-check available.
